rows.en: Use the Spiner!

The Spiner!?

Director, the Spiner's power is in a different league from the X Shell or the MN bomb! If we use something like that… Tokyo will be reduced to ruins!

Are you saying we should stand by and watch Japan's capital get trampled by kaiju? We'd be the laughingstock of the whole world!

It's come to this: a decisive battle for Tokyo!
Even so, there's no need to go as far as using the Spiner…

According to Officer Kishida… the oil monster Takkong has an X Shell time bomb lodged in it, doesn't it?

What's more, out at sea near where the kaiju appeared, there's a dynamite factory! That factory holds enough nitroglycerin to blow Tokyo away…

If the X Shell in the kaiju goes off near that factory… I don't need to explain what would happen, do I?
But, Director… Tokyo is full of people, including sick people who can't be moved!
We'll expand the evacuation advisory to cover all of Tokyo! Work with the Security Team and guide the citizens to safe areas, quickly!
That's reckless!

Kato!

In the decisive battle for Tokyo, I'll be in full command! All you need to do is follow orders!
You know what happens to those who disobey the Director's orders, don't you?
I know!
Go…

Hey, Go!

Are you planning to quit MAT?

I'm quitting!

How could I work under a director like that!
What are you saying!? Don't be such a spoiled brat!
Who are you calling spoiled?

Well, aren't you!

The moment something rubs you the wrong way, you just quit? You're not the only one who's angry!

What did you join MAT for? What have you even done since joining? Just because you've got somewhere to go back to… this is way too irresponsible!

Unlike you, I've got no home to go back to… so I'm never quitting MAT! I'm staking my life on MAT, believe it or not!

Come back to MAT! Let's do this together!!
Go…
Captain! Let's sortie at once, as the Director ordered!
Captain!
We'll move once the residents have finished evacuating!
Captain, do you intend to disobey the Director's orders?
I am MAT's captain! The mess MAT made… we'll clean up MAT's way!
Captain…
Atomic disintegration, huh… No wonder Makuu and the rest want it!
But… if he's invisible, there's no way to find him!

…!?

That's it! We can do that!
What is it, Shaider? A brilliant idea?
Yeah, a perfect one!
An evacuation advisory has been issued! Tokyo residents are to evacuate to the suburbs… that's what they're saying!

An evacuation advisory!?

Like hell! We've got our hands full here, Taki… We're searching for an important guest who slipped out of the TDF Hospital!!
Oyassan, this time even we can't do a thing! It seems the TDF is going to use the Spiner…
The Spiner!?

It's a new type of bomb said to be equivalent to 100 times One-Seven's Graviton!

Incidentally, it is not the Spider.
The Spiner!?

It's a new type of bomb they say is worth 400 Momo Bombs!

And it's not the Spider… it's the Spiner.
What? What's this Spider?
Why would they use something like that? For kaiju-busting… that's awfully large-scale, isn't it?
Surely… they don't mean to wipe out the mutant Jimmy Kitahara completely?
Anyway, let's go! Jimmy Kitahara should still be near there!
Mm…
Wait… none of you are evacuating?
If we evacuate, who'll fight the evil organizations?
No, but…

Until Takeshi and the others come back, we've got to hold down the fort!

Here… drink some coffee and pull yourself together.
Oyassan…
It seems Makuu and the others have given up too. No wonder, since he's invisible…
Makuu and the others gave up too, huh? I mean… he's invisible, so there's no way to find him.
Shaider Scope!!
Mr. Kitahara! Please don't move from there! I'm coming to help you now.
Commander Hessler!?
General Guiler!!
Jimmy Kitahara is ours! And you will all be eliminated!!
Subjugate!!
Kuh…
Mr. Sakata!!
Go…
Aki… How did this happen!?
She said she was going shopping… She was walking through an underground passage with a friend when that kaiju attacked.
Damn… So there really were people who didn't evacuate in time.
More importantly… aren't you supposed to be confined at home?
How did you know…
Captain Kato contacted me.
I really did see her!! And yet…

I've been through something like that myself…

If you saw a girl, you should stick to it no matter what. Even if you get disciplined, just hold your head high…

Yes!

But…

But, actually… I quit MAT!
I see… But are you really all right with that?
Ugh…
Sis!

Aki, Aki…

Doctor, how is she?
At the moment, I can't say… But she needs absolute rest.

Don't worry… Aki will never die!

Go… she held on to this to the very end!

She got her paycheck, so she wanted to buy you a shirt…

I told her not to go, with a kaiju out nearby… but she said only that department store had your size…
Thank you, Aki…
Excuse me!
Hello…
How is she doing?
Still can't say…

uncertain: U06017 onward: スパイナー rendered 'Spiner' (Return of Ultraman's bomb), distinct from the glossary's スパイダー = Spider; [HERO4]'s joke in U06051/U06053 depends on the two names.
U06045: 名事 read as 名案 (brilliant idea), as in B0062.
U06053: モモ爆弾なら400百個分 garbled; rendered as 400 Momo Bombs.
